QUOTE: `python/src/entropic/__init__.py` exposes the C symbols directly with lazy (PEP 562) imports, so `entropic install-engine` can run before the `.so` exists.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that lazy imports in `__init__.py` let `entropic install-engine` run before the `.so` exists. That is the substance of the item: the package imports without the engine, so an install-engine subcommand can ship inside it.
